fullNhlHistoricalGameCoverage.warning: Checking every completed game is distinct from obtaining a source-authentic historic prop for every game. Provider matching is independent; PrizePicks/Underdog historical lines require source provenance and tiers before any verified accuracy or EV claim.

directionalBenchmarks.warning: Always-Higher and Always-Lower are fixed directional counterfactuals on the same archived lines, not payout- or eligibility-aware strategies. Archived sample is incomplete; model choices were calculated retrospectively; many props share NHL games. Do not infer profitability or calibrated lineup probabilities.

historicalPrizePicksModelBacktest.warning: Actual archived PrizePicks lines, not synthetic thresholds. Goblin/Demon/Standard labels are unknown, so payout-based EV and tier accuracy cannot be claimed.

historicalSportsbookBacktest.warning: Research-only retrospective selection using archived sportsbook closing lines and official results. Not actual historical PrizePicks lines. Missing lines and post-selection bias limit generalization. No verified payouts or lineup EV.

prospectiveReliability.warning: Prospective directional skill and probability diagnostics only. Clustered uncertainty is grouped by NHL game; model winning probabilities and payout-adjusted returns are not verified.

prospectiveResearchAudit.warning: Standalone individual NHL prop preferences are graded without requiring lineup membership. Only a direction explicitly selected in an immutable pregame snapshot enters the prospective model rate. Earlier frozen probability vectors evaluated using a later-written policy are exploratory retrospective reconstruction and cannot be advertised as precommitted picks. Raw offered Higher/Lower sides are not predictions. Payouts, calibration and fantasy-platform settlements remain unverified.
